## AI-Related Bug Checklist (if the bug involves an AI feature)

- [ ] Does the bug involve incorrect or fabricated content in AI output? (Critical — tag with `ai-safety`)
- [ ] Does the bug involve unexpected token usage or cost spike? (Tag with `cost-alert`)
- [ ] Does the bug involve a prompt injection or security concern? (Tag with `security` and do not include full attack details in this public issue)
- [ ] Does the bug occur on every call or only occasionally? (Flaky AI responses are expected occasionally; consistent wrong behavior is a bug)
